description: This file is a Bash shell script designed to list tmux sessions on different sockets. It provides command-line options to specify socket names or paths, filter sessions by name, and scan all sockets under a specific directory. The script includes functions for usage display, session listing, and handles various error conditions related to socket management and command execution.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: list_sessions
methods.description: Lists tmux sessions for a given socket label, filtering by a query if specified, and displays session details.
